scope: subtitle blocks 220-345 (the acceptance meeting and the walk down Elm Street)

turns.speaker: t
turns.quote: What if I said you could stay here?

turns.speaker: g
turns.quote: Here?

turns.speaker: g
turns.quote: But even if you meant it, it's impossible.

turns.speaker: g
turns.quote:
It's very small town, I have to hide.
People will ask questions.

turns.speaker: t
turns.quote:
Well, it might not matter.
Not if they all wanted to help you too.

turns.speaker: g
turns.quote:
Are you saying that everybody
in this town is like you?

turns.speaker: t
turns.quote:
They're good people.
You know, they're honest people.

turns.speaker: t
turns.quote: They've all been in need themselves.

turns.speaker: t
turns.quote: They might well turn you down, but...

turns.speaker: t
turns.quote:
I think it would be worth
the trouble to ask.

turns.speaker: g
turns.quote: But I got nothing to offer them in return.

turns.speaker: t
turns.quote:
No, I think you have
plenty to offer Dogville.

turns.speaker: f
turns.quote: Now I'm sure that you wish us well, Tom,

turns.speaker: f
turns.quote:
but um.. of any town, I believe this one
has a very fine sense of community.

turns.speaker: f
turns.quote:
Living side by side we
all know one another.

turns.speaker: f
turns.quote:
I'm a pretty fair judge
of character myself.

turns.speaker: c
turns.quote: Honestly, Tom, you've done it again.

turns.speaker: c
turns.quote:
Made us come here to listen
to a lot of nonsense.

turns.speaker: c
turns.quote:
What do you think you are,
some kind of philosopher?

turns.speaker: t
turns.quote: Observant, that's what I am.

turns.speaker: c
turns.quote:
Lazy, I would say.
We shovel snow together.

turns.speaker: t
turns.quote: We shovel snow together?

turns.speaker: c
turns.quote: Yeah.

turns.speaker: t
turns.quote:
Every household clears
their own front walk.

turns.speaker: c
turns.quote:
Yeah, I gotta allow that Tom's right on that.
If roads don't get cleared properly...

turns.speaker: c
turns.quote:
I'm sorry Tom, you're going to have to
come up with something better than that.

turns.speaker: t
turns.quote:
But the whole country would be better served with
a greater attitude of openness and accenpance.

turns.speaker: c
turns.quote:
You're suggesting that we all
wouldn't help out if someone needed help.

turns.speaker: t
turns.quote:
No, that's not the point.
That's not the point.

turns.speaker: t
turns.quote: We care for human beings up here.

turns.speaker: c
turns.quote: We would probably never find out.

turns.speaker: t
turns.quote:
Allow me to introduce Grace.
Grace, these are the citizens of Dogville.

turns.speaker: f
turns.quote:
Tom has told us about
your predicament, Miss.

turns.speaker: g
turns.quote:
I really don't want to put any of you
in jeopardy.

turns.speaker: b
turns.quote:
I, I don't know if that's such a good idea.
The transportation
business would uh...

turns.speaker: c
turns.quote: Ben!

turns.speaker: b
turns.quote:
These men, they have powerful connections,
even with the police.

turns.speaker: t
turns.quote: She has a telephone.

turns.speaker: t
turns.quote: tell the town if people were coming.

turns.speaker: m
turns.quote:
But Tom, I chime the hours, what if
people get confused with all the ringing?

turns.speaker: t
turns.quote:
Come now, Martha. Surely we can use our
old bell to save a life, if need be.

turns.speaker: c
turns.quote: Why should we?

turns.speaker: t
turns.quote:
Because we care, Chuck.
We care for other human beings.

turns.speaker: c
turns.quote: No, that ain't what I mean.

turns.speaker: c
turns.quote:
How do we know that this woman is
telling us the truth?

turns.speaker: c
turns.quote:
Maybe these gangsters did shoot at her, but
that don't make her somebody to be trusted.

turns.speaker: g
turns.quote:
He is right.
Why would you trust me?

turns.speaker: f
turns.quote: I trust you!

turns.speaker: c
turns.quote: Tom, we're not gangsters.

turns.speaker: c
turns.quote:
We mind our own business
we don't ask nothin' from nobody.

turns.speaker: t
turns.quote: So at last you admit it!

turns.speaker: c
turns.quote:
If only there were some way,
we wouldn't doubt the young lady's word.

turns.speaker: c
turns.quote: Some way to know her..

turns.speaker: c
turns.quote: Then I think we would all ignore the risk.

turns.speaker: t
turns.quote:
But there is a way!
You said it yourself.

turns.speaker: t
turns.quote: By living side by side with her.

turns.speaker: t
turns.quote:
Dad, you are such a fine
judge of character.

turns.speaker: t
turns.quote:
How long would it take a good man
like you to unmask her?

turns.speaker: t
turns.quote: A week? Maybe two?

turns.speaker: t
turns.quote: Surely we can offer her two weeks.

turns.speaker: t
turns.quote:
And if after that time so much as
one man cries out 'BE GONE!'

turns.speaker: t
turns.quote:
I promise I'll happily send her
packing herself.

turns.speaker: f
turns.quote:
Well, if Master Tom thinks this is right
for us, and for the
community,

turns.speaker: f
turns.quote:
then that will do for me.
He might be young, but his heart is right.

turns.speaker: f
turns.quote:
And I've known his heart
for as long las it's been beating.

turns.speaker: t
turns.quote: Well, this is where Olivia and June live.

turns.speaker: t
turns.quote:
June is a cripple... They live here as
a token of my dad's broadmindedness.

turns.speaker: t
turns.quote:
Chuck and Vera have seven children
and they hate each other.

turns.speaker: t
turns.quote:
Next door we have the Hensons. They make a living from grinding
edges off cheap glasses to try to make them look expensive.

turns.speaker: t
turns.quote:
And here we have Jack McKay.
Now, Jack McKay is blind and the whole town knows it.

turns.speaker: t
turns.quote:
But he thinks he can hide it
by never leaving his house.

turns.speaker: t
turns.quote: In the old stable Ben keeps his truck.

turns.speaker: t
turns.quote:
He drinks and he visits the whorehouse
once a month and he is ashamed of it.

turns.speaker: t
turns.quote:
Martha she runs the mission house until the new
preacher comes which will just never happen.

turns.speaker: t
turns.quote:
That leaves Ma Ginger and Gloria.
They run this really expensive store,

turns.speaker: t
turns.quote:
where they exploit the fact
that nobody leaves town.

turns.speaker: t
turns.quote:
Used to leave to go vote,
but since they put on the registration fee,

turns.speaker: t
turns.quote:
about a day's wage for these people, they
don't feel the democratic need any more.

turns.speaker: t
turns.quote:
Those awful figurines say more about
the people in this town, than many words.

turns.speaker: g
turns.quote:
If this is the town that you love, then you
really have a strange way of showing it.

turns.speaker: t
turns.quote:
All I see, is a beautiful little town
in the midst of magnificent mountains.

turns.speaker: t
turns.quote:
A place where people have hopes and
dreams even under the hardest conditions.

turns.speaker: t
turns.quote:
And seven figurines that
are not awful at all.

turns.speaker: t
turns.quote: They are keeping an eye on you.

turns.speaker: t
turns.quote:
If you love them already,
they might need a little persuading.

turns.speaker: t
turns.quote:
You've got two weeks
to get them to accept you.

turns.speaker: g
turns.quote:
You make it sound like
we are playing a game.

turns.speaker: t
turns.quote:
It is. We are. Isn't saving your life
worth a little game?

turns.speaker: g
turns.quote: What do you want me to do?

turns.speaker: t
turns.quote: Do you mind physical labour?

turns.speaker: g
turns.quote: No!

turns.speaker: t
turns.quote: Dogville has offered you two weeks.

turns.speaker: t
turns.quote: Now you offer them...
